Do not add schema_version, run_id, metadata, or prose. Do not use git, install packages, make network requests, expose credentials, or write outside the assigned directory.

stages.description: Independently reproduce provenance, containment, startup-closure, and milestone-order facts.
Design disjoint external tests and critical mutants for the frozen selector contract.
Produce six isolated implementations using different risk charters.
Cross-review every implementation twice with executable reproducers.
Produce two independent integration candidates from validated components and findings.

Design eight independent provenance tests paired one-to-one with eight critical mutants for the selector contract. Cover offset/range, selector hash, literal hash, equality target, handler fallthrough, canonical index identity, startup-table identity, and stale corpus. Use IDs O01.T1-O01.T8 and O01.M1-O01.M8 with exact reciprocal pairs. Candidate code and candidate tests are never the oracle. blockers must be empty unless admitted evidence contradicts itself.

Design eight safe external guest-memory tests paired one-to-one with eight mutants. Cover explicit little-endian unaligned read, partial unit, exact 2^32 view end, null/error precedence, unchanged output, checked guest overflow, real high host pointer, and bounded alias backing. Use IDs O02.T1-O02.T8 and O02.M1-O02.M8 with exact reciprocal pairs. Never describe a view larger than its allocation. blockers must be empty unless admitted evidence contradicts itself.

Design eight selector tests paired one-to-one with eight mutants. Cover exact 44-byte match, first mismatch with a two-byte view, later mismatch with exact prefix extent, missing terminator, one-byte terminator, reversed policy, output preservation, and static rejection of wchar_t or unbounded scans. Use IDs O03.T1-O03.T8 and O03.M1-O03.M8 with exact reciprocal pairs. blockers must be empty unless admitted evidence contradicts itself.

Design eight build/containment tests paired one-to-one with eight mutants. Cover selector provenance fixture order, warning-hard x64 build, static test-only runtime linkage, unchanged four sparse bootstrap exports, KERNEL32-only DLL dependency, immutable explicit inputs without relying on git, LF provenance, and full regression execution. Use IDs O04.T1-O04.T8 and O04.M1-O04.M8 with exact reciprocal pairs. blockers must be empty unless admitted evidence contradicts itself; use no C backslash escapes in JSON prose.

Implement the frozen selector contract in your isolated directory with the smallest readable API/diff. Submit full revised guest32.h/c, new ported policy h/c, focused test_entry_policy.c, README.md, and submission.json with exact hashes and tests. Do not edit the repository copy.

Implement the frozen selector contract in your isolated directory, prioritizing arithmetic/range proofs and unchanged-output semantics. Produce the same required full source/test/README set and submission.json. Do not edit the repository copy.

Implement the frozen selector contract in your isolated directory using an explicitly bounded streaming comparison that proves early mismatch does not over-read. Produce the full source/test/README set and submission.json. Do not edit the repository copy.

Implement the frozen selector contract in your isolated directory with an adversarial table-driven test-first design. Produce the full source/test/README set and submission.json. Do not edit the repository copy or treat your tests as the oracle.

Implement the frozen selector contract in your isolated directory with comments/invariants limited to facts needed to prove bounds and state transitions. Produce the full source/test/README set and submission.json. Do not edit the repository copy.

Implement the frozen selector contract independently, minimizing helper/state complexity and actively avoiding patterns shared by the other charters. Produce the full source/test/README set and submission.json. Do not edit the repository copy.

Review the assigned three candidates for guest/host range arithmetic, output preservation, over-read, aliasing, and pointer-width defects. Every nontrivial finding needs a reproducible test that passes a known-good interpretation and fails the candidate. Write and validate findings.json in the assigned workspace.

Review the assigned three candidates for exact literal/terminator semantics, early mismatch, status precedence, policy reversal, wchar_t leakage, and unbounded reads. Require executable reproducers. Write and validate findings.json in the assigned workspace.

Review the assigned three candidates for compilability under the hardened x64 flags, deterministic test construction, source ownership, manifest accuracy, and accidental bootstrap/export/canonical coupling. Require executable reproducers. Write and validate findings.json in the assigned workspace.

Review the assigned three candidates against all hard rejection gates and actively seek correlated design failures missed by candidate-owned tests. Require executable reproducers and separate facts from style preferences. Write and validate findings.json in the assigned workspace.

Produce an isolated integration candidate for the frozen selector contract using only hash-validated candidate components and accepted review findings. Include full final guest32 h/c, ported policy h/c, adversarial C test, provenance-test proposal, CMake integration fragment, README, and integration_manifest.json. Do not edit the repository copy.

Independently produce an isolated integration candidate, preferring the simplest components that survive all accepted reproducers and central gates. Do not copy G01. Include the same complete file set and integration_manifest.json; do not edit the repository copy.
